text:
lee-support: FYI customer BlueCart opened a ticket — they saw a p99 jump to ~6.2s and a bunch of 502s on Dedicated API around 2025-11-05 11:03 UTC. attaching ticket and a couple trace ids: trc-9a8b, trc-9a8c :loud_sound:

sam-sre: on it. do we have pool id + any repro steps?

lee-support: ticket https://redwood.support/t/BC-1258. logs show repeated attach timeouts and gpu warmup errors. snippet: ```ERROR attach: timeout waiting for worker after 12s
WARN gpu_warmup: exceeded warmup_timeout (10s)```

deploy-bot: autoscale event -> {"event":"scale_up_request","pool":"d-pool-43","requested":2,"status":"queued","time":"2025-11-05T11:03:10Z"}

sam-sre: initial look: attach_latency p99 spiked to ~9s at 11:02, provisioning queue depth climbed. probable late attach + cold GPU start. adding mike-platform.

mike-platform: I see correlating node-level metrics — image pull times spiked and disk I/O on a subset of hosts caused warmup to slip >10s. kube attach retries also jumped. hypothesis: concurrent attach fanout hit a few busy hosts -> queued requests -> client-side timeouts -> 502s.

jess-prod: customer is pinned to rwd-13b-quant, any safe fallback we can offer quickly to reduce warmup cost? maybe route to rwd-7b-quant if latency is priority.

sam-sre: immediate mitigations we can try: bump min_pool for that dedicated pool, increase attach timeout so requests don't 502 while warmup completes, and enable proactive_prewarm.

mike-platform: applied quick patch to pool config: min_pool 2 -> 4, attach_timeout 12s -> 20s, proactive_prewarm enabled for 1 hour. rollout id cfg-20251105-01.

deploy-bot: config update applied to pool=d-pool-43 at 2025-11-05T11:12:02Z (cfg-20251105-01).

lee-support: customer reports errors dropped to near 0 and p99 back to ~1.1s after the changes. they want RCA + long-term fixes.

sam-sre: follow-ups: 1) repro in staging with high concurrency to trigger attach queue and validate fix; 2) dig into why image pulls / disk I/O spiked on that node subset — might need pre-pulled images or larger image cache; 3) add proactive warmup trigger when attach_queue_depth > 3; 4) add alert for attach_queue_depth and warmup_fail_rate.

mike-platform: also proposing smarter routing: if pool shows recent warmup failures, automatically route to alternate compatible pool/region or model_variant. will draft RFC.

jess-prod: i'll document an opt-in customer config: {"auto_fallback_model":true,"proactive_prewarm":true} and propose defaults for Dedicated.

ops-bot: created incident INC-20251105-BC1258, priority=P2, owners=[sam-sre,mike-platform].

sam-sre: assigning, will run repro and gather host-level traces (container logs, image-pull times, kube attach trace) and update ticket. tagging @jess-prod for product config follow-up.

lee-support: thanks — logging notes to the support ticket and emailing customer that we applied a temporary mitigation. will follow up after RCA. :thumbsup:
